buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.0 The bidder shall quote a single lumpsum price on the GeM portal, on "F.O.R. Salem Steel Plant" basis, f or the complete scope of work, i.e., Design, supply, installation, integration, configuration, testing, commis sioning, training and maintenance of AI based safety monitoring system, as per the scope of work/specifica tions of the tender. The price shall be inclusive of GST and all other applicable taxes, duties and levies. Uni t-wise or item-wise prices shall not be quoted 2.0 Payment terms as per the specifications. 3.0 Unless otherwise specified in the tender terms, the inspection will be at Salem Steel Plant after receipt

of the consignment. 4.0 The bidder shall enclose signed and sealed copy of the technical specification, as a token to acceptanc e to the tendered item's specification. 5.0 The bidder shall not quote/attach any price/price bid format along with their technical offe r. The offer of such bidder will be summarily rejected. 6.0 The MII/MSE preference's shall only be given to bidders subject to submission/verification of valid MII c ertificate/Udhayam Certificate. 7.0 The bidders are required to self certify the local content in their product for purchase value less than R s.10 crore. For purchases more than Rs.10 crore, as per para 9 (b) of PPP-MII Order, 2017, a certificate fro m the statutory auditor or cost auditor of the company (in the case of companies) or from a practicing cost accountant or practicing chartered accountant (in respect of suppliers other than companies) is required to be submitted. 8.0 The applicable EMD amount is Rs.1,00,000/- only (Rupees one Lakhs Only), However, bidders can sub mit "Bid Securing Declaration" in lieu of EMD, duly signed & sealed. 9.0 The bidder shall peremptorily enclose duly filled, signed and sealed copy of "Acceptance of Commercial Terms and Conditions, Statement of Deviation, Bid Securing Declaration, Undertaking Letter,N on Collusive Tendering Certificate, Certificate for near relaltives and land border sharing clause" under the header “Additional Doc 1 (Requested in ATC)” and other documents, as sought in eligibility criteria along w ith their technical offer. 10.0 The bidder shall submit the required documents sought under the "Eligibility Criteria" for evaluation o f their offer. 11.0 The bidders, submitting Profit/Loss statement issued by practicing Chartered Accountants should hav e Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN), as mandated by Institute of Chartered Accountants of In dia(ICAI). 12.0 Salem Steel Plant has implemented Anti-Bribery Management System (ABMS) as per ISO 37001:2016 standard and in order to involve the external agencies, the following undertaking is taken from the Supplie rs /Contractors / Vendors “By participating in this tender, the Suppliers/Vendors/Customers are deemed to have undertaken that they shall not give or take any financial or non-financial bribe, to or from anyone dur ing the tender or during the execution of the contract, thereafter and if they notice any such incident happ ening, they shall report to SAIL Vigilance.” 13.0 The sucessfull bidder is required to submit security deposit of 3% (Three Percentage) of Total Order v alue in the form of Demand Draft/Bank Guarantee. The SDBG should be valid for the period till completion of delivery period as per the purchase order with claim period of six months from the date of expiry. .
